data: Apple reported diluted earnings per share of $6.13 for fiscal 2023, which ended September 30, 2023, compared with $6.11 for fiscal 2022. That is an increase of about 0.3%. The small gain came even though net income fell, because Apple's continued share buybacks reduced the diluted share count. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $96.995 billion, down roughly 2.8% from $99.803 billion in fiscal 2022.
